convert_sam2_checkpoint: convert a SAM2 checkpoint from Facebook's repository to HuggingFace format
run_convert_cli: run the SAM2 video checkpoint converter CLI tool with model name and checkpoint path
get_config: get a Sam2VideoConfig for a specified SAM2 model variant
replace_keys: replace and remap state dict keys from original SAM2 to HuggingFace naming convention
push_to_hub: push the converted SAM2 model and processor to the HuggingFace Hub
